items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Maybe it was Gilly Coggins… Yeah, maybe it was Gilly.

ctx.x: Kenny Clarke. And who was playing piano? I don’t remember who was playing piano at that time. Jimmy made some of the gigs up in Boston with the Symphony Sid All-Stars. It might have been Kenny Drew, not sure about the piano player. But that’s some more association with Miles that I had, and Kenny, Kenny Clarke. Maybe it was Gilly Coggins…

Yeah, maybe it was Gilly. But the Symphony Sid All-Stars, and oh yeah, JJ Johnson was in that too. We played around there in the Downbeat with that group. The two clubs were interrelated anyhow. Being in New York then working sometimes with Miles, made these record dates with Miles and everybody else who recorded for Prestige at that time, Thad Jones, you mentioned Art Farmer, who had left the Jazztet, he and Benny had when Tootie was playing with them incidentally. You remember the Jazztet?
